meta.name: The Signal
meta.description: A missing astronaut sets her family on a frantic hunt for answers. But the more they uncover, the greater the threat becomes to them — and the world.

videos.title: Vanished
videos.overview: Astronaut Paula is on her way back from a mission. Her husband Sven and daughter Charlie are excited to see her when they receive upsetting news.

videos.title: Paula
videos.overview: In space, Paula starts to question herself as the weight of her discovery sinks in. Sven and Charlie deal with the fallout of the accident.

videos.title: Black Box
videos.overview: Sven faces new threats and makes unexpected allies in his search for the truth. Paula deals with a traitor during a critical phase of her mission.

videos.title: Departure
videos.overview: Forced to evade a powerful enemy, Sven puts his faith in Charlie as they try to solve the final piece of Paula's puzzle.
